summary: The audit checks 20 units of CEE courses numbered 200 or above, taken at Stanford, leaving out special studies, research and thesis courses. You check by hand the 3.0 GPA in those courses, the application approved by both your major and the CEE department, and your minor advisor (CEE faculty, Academic Council, on your oral and reading committees) approving the course list with the CEE chair.

jKkxGVD3.why: "The program must include at least 20 graduate-level coursework units (courses numbered 200 or above, excluding special studies and thesis) in CEE completed at Stanford University. The list of courses must form a coherent program and must be approved by the minor program advisor and the CEE chair. A minimum GPA of 3.0 must be achieved in these courses." Policies: "Application for the PhD minor must be approved by both the major and the minor department." Special studies and thesis are the CEE courses titled independent study, research, special study, problems, practical training, thesis or TGR.
